question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, SUM(best_points) AS total_combined_points
    FROM (
        SELECT cr.constructor_id, MAX(cr.points) AS best_points
        FROM constructor_results cr
        JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
        WHERE cr.points IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY cr.constructor_id, r.year
    ) AS yearly_best
    GROUP BY constructor_id
),
top3_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructor_id
    FROM constructor_totals
    ORDER BY total_combined_points DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT c.name, yt.year, yt.best_points, ct.total_combined_points
FROM constructor_totals ct
JOIN constructors_ext c ON ct.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
JOIN (
    SELECT constructor_id, year, best_points
    FROM (
        SELECT cr.constructor_id, r.year, MAX(cr.points) AS best_points
        FROM constructor_results cr
        JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
        WHERE cr.points IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY cr.constructor_id, r.year
    )
) yt ON ct.constructor_id = yt.constructor_id
WHERE ct.constructor_id = 9
ORDER BY yt.year

WITH constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, SUM(best_points) AS total_combined_points
    FROM (
        SELECT cr.constructor_id, MAX(cr.points) AS best_points
        FROM constructor_results cr
        JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
        WHERE cr.points IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY cr.constructor_id, r.year
    ) AS yearly_best
    GROUP BY constructor_id
),
top3_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructor_id
    FROM constructor_totals
    ORDER BY total_combined_points DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT c.name, yt.year, yt.best_points, ct.total_combined_points
FROM constructor_totals ct
JOIN constructors_ext c ON ct.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
JOIN (
    SELECT constructor_id, year, best_points
    FROM (
        SELECT cr.constructor_id, r.year, MAX(cr.points) AS best_points
        FROM constructor_results cr
        JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
        WHERE cr.points IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY cr.constructor_id, r.year
    )
) yt ON ct.constructor_id = yt.constructor_id
WHERE ct.constructor_id = 9
ORDER BY yt.year
